This is a quick report for anyone who might be interested in this stuff.
I have done most everything under the sun, and for those expecting anything similar to MDMA or 4MMC this is not for you.
This is a powerful chemical with which one must what the
dose. If one doesn't have a scale, start VERY small on this chemical because it is strong. A few grains of this powder will knock me on my ass.
I am a big guy and have never dealt with anything so powerful: small dose = big effect. A fine dusting of this powder on a fingertip is way more than enough. If one has never used this drug and choose to ignore this advice and don't have a scale - eyeball 5 grains of salt of this drug.
With that said, I honestly don't love this substance.
There are people who say this is  the 'tryptamine's answer to MDMA' which is not true. I don't think this person has had real MDMA. I've had pure molly countless times and this is not at all similar. This stuff is trippy - much like mushrooms - but don't expect anything at all related to MDMA or 4MMC euphoria.
5-meo-mipt is a tryptamine, one will trip HARD on this drug in strong doses (10-20+mg). As with most tryptamines this trippiness comes at a price - a strong load on my digestive system. Tryptamines are hard on my gastro-intestinal tract and 5-meo-mipt is no exception.
I may get tripped-out, but this will last for a few hours and I'll be on the shitter for at least a day. I used some pure 5-meo-mipt a few times, and found my stomach had aches for 24 hours after the peak wore off and I will be pooping lots.
The stimulation and stomach pain make it hard to sleep, so I don't expect any proper sleep even long after taking even a small dose.
All in all, a very strong trippy experience but the lingering stomach pains and sleep problems make it not worth it.
